sqlLang.sumNonNullValues: The sum of the non-null values; null when there are none.
sqlLang.sumFloat00: The sum as a float; 0.0 when there are no values.
sqlLang.meanNonNullValues: The mean of the non-null values.
sqlLang.oneArgumentSmallestValue: With one argument, the smallest value in the group; with several, the smallest of them.
sqlLang.oneArgumentLargestValue: With one argument, the largest value in the group; with several, the largest of them.
sqlLang.nonNullValuesJoined: The non-null values joined into one string, comma-separated unless told otherwise.
sqlLang.firstArgumentNotNull: The first argument that is not null.
sqlLang.xYWhenX: X, or Y when X is null.
sqlLang.nullWhenXEquals: Null when X equals Y, otherwise X. nullif(x, 0) keeps a zero out of a division.
sqlLang.thenWhenConditionHolds: then when the condition holds, else otherwise.
sqlLang.xRoundedSoMany: X rounded to so many digits after the point (0 by default).
sqlLang.charactersStringBytesBlob: Characters in a string, bytes in a blob.
sqlLang.partString1Based: Part of a string, from a 1-based start; a negative start counts from the end.
sqlLang.whereYFirstAppears: Where Y first appears in X, 1-based; 0 when it does not.
sqlLang.xEveryYReplaced: X with every Y replaced by Z.
sqlLang.xWithoutLeadingTrailing: X without leading and trailing spaces (or the characters given).
sqlLang.xWithoutLeadingSpaces: X without leading spaces (or the characters given).
sqlLang.xWithoutTrailingSpaces: X without trailing spaces (or the characters given).
sqlLang.stringBuiltFormatC: A string built from a format, as in C: printf('%.1f%%', share * 100).
sqlLang.storageClassNullInteger: The storage class: null, integer, real, text or blob.
sqlLang.dateYyyyMmDd: The date, YYYY-MM-DD: date(commit_time), date('now', '-90 days').
sqlLang.dateTimeYyyyMm: The date and time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
sqlLang.daysSinceNoon24: Days since noon, 24 November 4714 BC: subtract two to get days between.
sqlLang.dateFormattedStrftimeY: A date formatted: strftime('%Y-%m', commit_time) for months.
sqlLang.valueJsonTextJson: A value from JSON text: json_extract(value, '$.name').
sqlLang.rankWindowGapsAfter: The rank in the window, with gaps after ties.
sqlLang.rankWindowWithoutGaps: The rank in the window, without gaps.
sqlLang.whichNNearEqual: Which of N near-equal buckets the row falls in.
sqlLang.xRowBeforeWindow: X from a row before, in the window's order.
sqlLang.xRowAfterWindow: X from a row after, in the window's order.
sqlLang.xFirstRowWindow: X at the first row of the window frame.
sqlLang.xLastRowWindow: X at the last row of the window frame.
sqlLang.tableSColumnsRows: A table's columns as rows: cid, name, type, notnull, dflt_value, pk.
sqlLang.elementsJsonArrayObject: The elements of a JSON array or object, one row each.
sqlLang.columnQueryNames: A column of {table}, as this query names it.
sqlLang.commonTableExpressionQuery: A common table expression of this query.
sqlLang.oneRowPerComponent: One row per component: its size, coupling, health, history and graph measures.
sqlLang.oneRowPerFile: One row per file: its component, role, size, health and history.
sqlLang.oneRowPerDirectory: One row per directory, with its files' measures rolled up.
sqlLang.importsBetweenComponentsOne: Imports between components: one row per importing file and import, from → to.

sqlLang.tanglesComponentsCanAll: Tangles: components that can all reach each other, by group.
sqlLang.shortestImportCycleThrough: The shortest import cycle through each component.

sqlLang.oneRowPerAuthor: One row per author: commits, lines and files changed, over each period.

sqlLang.pairsComponentsChangedSame: Pairs of components changed in the same commits, and how often.

sqlLang.dependencyRulesEachImport: Dependency rules and each import they judge: status, from, to, file and line.

sqlLang.piecesSourceEngineKept: Pieces of source the engine kept: imports, declarations, by type.
sqlLang.declaredUnitsTypesFunctions: Declared units: types, functions and modules, with their spans.
sqlLang.whatEachMetricMeans: What each metric means: its name and descriptions.
sqlLang.howSnapshotWasMade: How the snapshot was made: commit, branch, analysis revision, ignore patterns.
